verses.mystical_translation: Leadership begins with what power permits inside its own house.
The poem enters through royal ethics, integrity, slander, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.
Its center asks what becomes possible when memory, power, vulnerability, and desire are held in the presence of the Divine rather than acted out automatically.
